script: The worst extinction in Earth's history happened about 252 million years ago. It is called the Great Dying, at the end of the Permian period. Scientists estimate around 80 to 90 percent of sea species died out. Huge volcanic eruptions in what is now Siberia are the main suspect. They released enormous amounts of carbon dioxide, heating the planet and its oceans. Among the survivors were the ancestors of the first dinosaurs. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
